name: FFIST predictable airdrop balance overwrite
summary: FFIST._airdrop sets the balance of addresses derived from lastAirdropAddress, block number, sender, recipient and amount to one raw unit, overwriting whatever they held. A zero-value transfer to a crafted recipient made the derived address the USDT pair; after sync, a tiny FFIST sale drained the pair's USDT.
notes: The anchor is the only transfer that overwrote the pair's balance (the only FFIST Transfer from the pair to itself), and FFIST has no other pair. Later sales of small FFIST holdings into the broken pool came from pre-exploit holders, not exploit transactions, so they are neither campaign nor loss.
